_note: Manual corrections that survive every refresh. The fetch scripts apply these after pulling from ADS and GitHub, so anything you fix here stays fixed.

_howto.hidePublications: Bibcodes to exclude entirely — duplicates, or a paper by a different M. Fumagalli that slipped through.
_howto.publicationFixes: bibcode -> a partial object merged over the fetched entry, e.g. { "title": "corrected title" }
_howto.repoNotes: repo name -> a sentence of your own, shown under the GitHub description.
